items.name: base
items.title: Manga base
items.description: Shared foundation for every mangacn item: ink/paper tokens mapped onto shadcn variables (dark mode is the negative) and one accent colour, --mg-accent (stamp red by default; presets via data-accent="indigo|pine|ochre"), which also drives --destructive. Screentone utilities (tone-10/20/35/50, tone-lines, tone-cross, tone-fade-r/l/t/b, tone-frame), on-tone (paper plate for labels over tones), knockout (outline for heavy SFX), speed-lines and focus-lines, tone-shadow (offset screentone, never a blur), ink-fill, focus-ink, border-ink, shape-burst, edge-jagged, mark-error, a reading-rtl: variant for manga reading order (data-reading="rtl"), a screentone veil for every shadcn overlay, and stepped 12 fps animations. Installed automatically as a dependency of every other item.
items.docs: mangacn base installed. Tones: tone-10|20|35|50, tone-lines, tone-cross, tone-fade-r|l|t|b, tone-frame; labels over tones go on an on-tone plate. Energy: speed-lines, focus-lines. Ink: border-ink, ink-fill, focus-ink, tone-shadow (positioned element). Accent: --mg-accent or data-accent="indigo|pine|ochre". Manga reading order: data-reading="rtl" + the reading-rtl: variant.

meta.tagline: Ink, paper and one accent colour, screentone, speed lines, stepped motion.
meta.usage: Chapter 1

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Button. Variants: default (ink flat), outline, tone (screentone band on the bottom third, label on paper), ghost, link (wavy underline that thickens on hover), destructive (accent colour, jagged edge), shout (burst shape for the one call to action on a page; its focus ring is a second burst). Sizes sm, default, lg, icon. Hover: a screentone shadow appears. Pressed: 2px offset and a negative that stays visible in dark mode. Disabled: dashed line, tone frame, label on paper. Adds loading (concentration lines turning in steps, aria-busy) and fullWidth.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/button". It wraps your own components/ui/button, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Ink flats, a tone band, a burst for the one call to action.
meta.usage:
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/manga/button"

<Button variant="shout" size="lg">Start!</Button>
<Button variant="outline" loading>Saving</Button>

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows turning focus lines, sets aria-busy, disables the button.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Input. 2px ink line that thickens to 3px on focus, italic placeholder, fine line when read-only, dashed line + light tone when disabled, and an error look on aria-invalid (stamp red, serrated bottom edge, "!" mark). Sizes via inputSize: sm, default, lg.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/input". It wraps your own components/ui/input, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A 2px ink line that thickens on focus; serrated with a “!” on error.
meta.usage:
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/manga/input"

<Input placeholder="Pen name" />
<Input aria-invalid defaultValue="reader@" />

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Checkbox. Square ink box; hover thickens the line (no screentone under 24px); checked is an ink flat with a brush check that draws itself in three frames; indeterminate is a thick bar; disabled is dashed; aria-invalid uses the accent colour.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/checkbox". It wraps your own components/ui/checkbox, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A square box; the brush check draws itself.
meta.usage:
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/manga/checkbox"

<label className="flex items-center gap-3">
  <Checkbox defaultChecked /> Notify me
</label>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Switch, 44 × 24 px. Off: paper track and ink thumb. On: ink track and paper thumb. Hover thickens the line, disabled is dashed, aria-invalid uses the accent colour.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/switch". It wraps your own components/ui/switch, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Paper track and ink thumb when off, the negative when on.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Badge in lettering type. Variants: default (ink flat), outline, tone (screentone tab at the start, label on paper), destructive (clean accent flat), burst ("NEW!" star) and stamp (tilted accent stamp). Optional square status dot; icons via data-icon.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/badge". It wraps your own components/ui/badge, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Ink, outline, burst and a tilted stamp.
meta.usage:
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/manga/badge"

<Badge variant="burst">New!</Badge>
<Badge variant="outline" dot>Live</Badge>

props.name: dot
props.description: Square status dot before the label.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Skeleton: a light screentone (tone-10) that flickers in steps instead of pulsing in opacity, no heavy frame. Shapes: text, avatar, panel, block. SkeletonCard composes a card placeholder.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/skeleton". It wraps your own components/ui/skeleton, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A light screentone that flickers while content loads.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toast (Sonner)
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Sonner Toaster: 3px panel with an offset second frame, stepped entrance, lettering titles, ink marks for success / info / warning / error, concentration lines while loading, a shake on error. ToastSfx adds an onomatopoeia in its own column. ToastCard renders a static toast with the same look for previews and docs.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/sonner". It wraps your own components/ui/sonner, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Toasts in a 3px panel, with room for a sound effect.
meta.usage:
import { Toaster, toast, ToastSfx } from "@/components/ui/manga/sonner"

<Toaster />

toast.success("Subscribed!")
toast("Level up!", { icon: <ToastSfx>DON!</ToastSfx> })

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Card as a comic panel: 3px frame and an offset screentone shadow. Variants: default, bleed (first image runs to the edges), tilted (slanted bottom edge drawn in SVG; the content stays upright), splash (focus lines around a wide empty centre, title on a paper plate), beta (ink flat). interactive lifts it on hover; selected adds a double ink frame.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/card". It wraps your own components/ui/card, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A comic panel with a screentone shadow.
meta.usage:
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/card"

<Card variant="tilted">
  <CardHeader><CardTitle>Chapter 12</CardTitle></CardHeader>
  <CardContent>The long night.</CardContent>
</Card>

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Tabs. Variants: index (chapter dividers, active tab is an ink flat), underline (thick ink line), pills (paper tabs on a light tone). Labels always sit on paper. Horizontal and vertical; disabled tabs are dashed with a tone frame.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/tabs". It wraps your own components/ui/tabs, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Chapter dividers, a thick underline or boxed tabs.
meta.usage:
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/tabs"

<Tabs variant="index" defaultValue="v1">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="v1">Vol. 1</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="v2">Vol. 2</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="v1">…</TabsContent>
</Tabs>

props.name: variant
props.description: Set on <Tabs>; lists and triggers follow.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Dialog: centred 3px panel with a screentone shadow, opening on an impact frame; the overlay is a light screentone fixed to the screen (no blur, no moiré when zooming). Sizes sm, default, lg, full. DialogBody adds a scrolling region that keeps the shadow outside.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/dialog". It wraps your own components/ui/dialog, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A centred panel over a light screentone veil.
meta.usage:
import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/manga/dialog"

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger>Open</DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent size="sm"><DialogTitle>Leave the chapter?</DialogTitle></DialogContent>
</Dialog>

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Tooltip as a mini speech bubble with a curved tail (or two circles for thought) that follows the side; the offset leaves room for the tail. TooltipBubble renders a static bubble for previews and docs.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/tooltip". It wraps your own components/ui/tooltip, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A tiny speech or thought bubble.
meta.usage:
import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/tooltip"

<Tooltip>
  <TooltipTrigger>Hover me</TooltipTrigger>
  <TooltipContent variant="thought">Maybe tomorrow.</TooltipContent>
</Tooltip>

items.name: speech-bubble
items.title: Speech Bubble
items.description: Manga speech bubble drawn in SVG at its real size and inscribed in its box, with real text inside. Variants: speech, thought (cloud), shout (spikes), whisper (dashed), narration (caption box), electronic (zigzag), wobbly (trembling). The tail points to top, bottom, start or end, aligned start/center/end, or none, and its room is reserved as margin. BubbleGroup chains bubbles through a neck that hides both outlines.

meta.tagline: Seven bubble shapes drawn at their real size.
meta.usage:
import { SpeechBubble, BubbleGroup } from "@/components/manga/speech-bubble"

<SpeechBubble variant="shout" tail="bottom" tailAlign="end">Get down!</SpeechBubble>

items.name: screentone
items.title: Screentone
items.description: Screentone as a component: dots, lines, cross-hatching or noise, with density, angle and cell size (SVG patterns with patternTransform), and a stepped (never smooth) fade toward any side. Use it as a background (put labels on a plate with on-tone) or as a layer over art. Coloured by --tone-ink.

meta.tagline: Any tone: dots, lines, cross-hatching or noise, with a stepped fade.
meta.usage:
import { Screentone } from "@/components/manga/screentone"

<Screentone density={35} fade="bottom" className="h-48">Night falls</Screentone>

props.name: as
props.description: Behind children or overlaid on the parent.

items.name: speed-lines
items.title: Speed Lines
items.description: Emphasis lines drawn in SVG at the real size: focus (radial concentration lines with an empty centre and a movable origin) or motion (tapered parallel lines at any direction). Density control, optional stepped animation (off with reduced motion). Children sit on top with a paper knockout, ideal for SFX.

meta.tagline: Focus or motion lines to make a moment hit.
meta.usage: import { SpeedLines } from "@/components/manga/speed-lines" ドン!
